searchText: Looking for a CL branch that has a working fcr implementation on top of gloas or even an implementation on top of fulu will do for now cc <@604453604769923092> <@425572898787426305> in which channel is fcr being discussed in? I can't find an fcr channel here on the left side https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/releases/tag/v1.44.0 will work. Use `--chain.fastConfirmation` flag. do you have any debug log entry for fcr? or only the evenstream? ``` Jul-07 12:39:57.007[chain] verbose: Updating fast confirmation variables previousSlotHead=0xa0667ccd1ffb95f4e9e4c93cbbf11e5a4e90160e35d690b066205bcf4f014cfe, currentSlotHead=0xa0667ccd1ffb95f4e9e4c93cbbf11e5a4e90160e35d690b066205bcf4f014cfe, currentSlot=-1, isStartSlotOfCurrentEpoch=false, isLastSlotOfCurrentEpoch=true ``` looks like I found it already yes it's "fast confirmation" if you search in logs. We also have a debug endpoint in `lodestar` namespace in REST api, in addition to official event stream interface. https://github.com/ethpandaops/dora/pull/792 WIP This pr https://github.com/grandinetech/grandine/pull/656 there is no dedicated channel, we used <#595701173944713277> cc <@688748669268132001> <@363800010518822915> i guess this version of nimbus have FCR enabled: https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/releases#release-v26.6.0 there is no feature flag in Nimbus 👍 any flags? or default enabled? Yes this --fast-confirmation-rule yup found it already ```yaml participants_matrix: el: - el_type: geth cl: - cl_type: lodestar cl_extra_params: - --chain.fastConfirmation=true - cl_type: nimbus - cl_type: grandine cl_image: ethpandaops/grandine:bomanaps-feature-fcr-minimal cl_extra_params: - --fast-confirmation-rule - cl_type: prysm count: 2 global_log_level: debug network_params: preset: minimal additional_services: - dora dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:bbusa-fcr ``` seems like its working nice, also tried some non finality this is great! thanks <@412614104222531604> one thing to check specifically for Gloas is that the `safe` block on EL is at least one slot behind a confirmed beacon block

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
```yaml
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: geth

  cl:
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_extra_params:
        - --chain.fastConfirmation=true
    - cl_type: nimbus
    - cl_type: grandine
      cl_image: ethpandaops/grandine:bomanaps-feature-fcr-minimal
      cl_extra_params:
        - --fast-confirmation-rule
    - cl_type: prysm
  count: 2
global_log_level: debug
network_params:
  preset: minimal

additional_services:
  - dora
dora_params: 
  image: ethpandaops/dora:bbusa-fcr
```
